read_queries.sql: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('database',DATABASE(),'account',CURRENT_USER(),'connection_user',USER(),'role',CAST(CURRENT_ROLE() AS CHAR),'host',@@hostname,'port',@@port,'uuid',@@server_uuid,'version',VERSION(),'mandatory_roles',@@GLOBAL.mandatory_roles,'partial_revokes',@@GLOBAL.partial_revokes,'session_sql_mode',@@SESSION.sql_mode,'global_sql_mode',@@GLOBAL.sql_mode,'session_time_zone',@@SESSION.time_zone,'global_time_zone',@@GLOBAL.time_zone,'system_time_zone',@@system_time_zone,'database_charset',@@character_set_database,'database_collation',@@collation_database,'foreign_key_checks',@@foreign_key_checks,'server_read_only',@@GLOBAL.read_only,'session_now',CAST(NOW() AS CHAR),'utc_now',CAST(UTC_TIMESTAMP() AS CHAR))
SHOW GRANTS
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('applicable',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.APPLICABLE_ROLES),'enabled',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.ENABLED_ROLES))

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('grantee',GRANTEE,'privilege_type',PRIVILEGE_TYPE,'is_grantable',IS_GRANTABLE) FROM information_schema.USER_PRIVILEGES WHERE GRANTEE=CONCAT(QUOTE('aurel_catalog_ro'),'@',QUOTE('127.0.0.1'))

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('grantee',GRANTEE,'table_schema',TABLE_SCHEMA,'privilege_type',PRIVILEGE_TYPE,'is_grantable',IS_GRANTABLE) FROM information_schema.SCHEMA_PRIVILEGES WHERE GRANTEE=CONCAT(QUOTE('aurel_catalog_ro'),'@',QUOTE('127.0.0.1'))

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('grantee',GRANTEE,'table_schema',TABLE_SCHEMA,'table_name',TABLE_NAME,'privilege_type',PRIVILEGE_TYPE,'is_grantable',IS_GRANTABLE) FROM information_schema.TABLE_PRIVILEGES WHERE GRANTEE=CONCAT(QUOTE('aurel_catalog_ro'),'@',QUOTE('127.0.0.1'))

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('grantee',GRANTEE,'table_schema',TABLE_SCHEMA,'table_name',TABLE_NAME,'column_name',COLUMN_NAME,'privilege_type',PRIVILEGE_TYPE,'is_grantable',IS_GRANTABLE) FROM information_schema.COLUMN_PRIVILEGES WHERE GRANTEE=CONCAT(QUOTE('aurel_catalog_ro'),'@',QUOTE('127.0.0.1'))

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('name',TABLE_NAME,'kind',TABLE_TYPE,'engine',ENGINE,'collation',TABLE_COLLATION,'estimated_rows',TABLE_ROWS) FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME IN ('location','attraction','attraction_image','hotel','hotel_image','guide_category','guide_post','migrations') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('table',TABLE_NAME,'name',COLUMN_NAME,'type',COLUMN_TYPE,'nullable',IS_NULLABLE,'default',COLUMN_DEFAULT,'extra',EXTRA,'collation',COLLATION_NAME) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME IN ('location','attraction','attraction_image','hotel','hotel_image','guide_category','guide_post','migrations') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('table',TABLE_NAME,'name',INDEX_NAME,'unique',IF(NON_UNIQUE=0,1,0),'position',SEQ_IN_INDEX,'column',COLUMN_NAME,'prefix',SUB_PART) FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME IN ('location','attraction','attraction_image','hotel','hotel_image','guide_category','guide_post','migrations') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,SEQ_IN_INDEX

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('table',k.TABLE_NAME,'constraint',k.CONSTRAINT_NAME,'column',k.COLUMN_NAME,'referenced_table',k.REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME,'referenced_column',k.REFERENCED_COLUMN_NAME,'update_rule',r.UPDATE_RULE,'delete_rule',r.DELETE_RULE) FROM information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE k LEFT JOIN information_schema.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS r ON r.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA=k.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA AND r.TABLE_NAME=k.TABLE_NAME AND r.CONSTRAINT_NAME=k.CONSTRAINT_NAME WHERE k.TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND k.REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME IS NOT NULL AND (k.TABLE_NAME IN ('location','attraction','attraction_image','hotel','hotel_image','guide_category','guide_post','migrations') OR k.REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME IN ('location','attraction','guide_category','guide_post')) ORDER BY k.TABLE_NAME,k.CONSTRAINT_NAME,k.ORDINAL_POSITION
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('count',COUNT(*)) FROM location
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('count',COUNT(*)) FROM attraction
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('count',COUNT(*)) FROM hotel
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('count',COUNT(*)) FROM hotel_image
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('count',COUNT(*)) FROM migrations

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('migration',migration,'batch',batch) FROM migrations WHERE migration IN ('2026_10_23_000001_add_experience_catalog_metadata','2026_10_23_000002_create_travel_guides','2026_10_23_000003_widen_guide_publication_datetime') ORDER BY migration
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id',id,'name',name,'region',region,'country',country,'latitude',latitude,'longitude',longitude) FROM location ORDER BY id LIMIT 500

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id',id,'location_id',location_id,'item_type',item_type,'name',name,'description',description,'address',address,'price_min',price_min,'price_max',price_max,'duration_hours',duration_hours,'open_time',open_time,'close_time',close_time,'lat',lat,'lng',lng,'is_active',is_active) FROM attraction ORDER BY id LIMIT 500
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id',id,'location_id',location_id,'name',name,'address',address,'status',status,'latitude',latitude,'longitude',longitude) FROM hotel ORDER BY id LIMIT 500
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id',id,'hotel_id',hotel_id,'image_url',image_url,'is_primary',is_primary,'caption',caption) FROM hotel_image ORDER BY id LIMIT 500
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('count',COUNT(*)) FROM attraction a LEFT JOIN location l ON l.id=a.location_id WHERE l.id IS NULL

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('location_id',location_id,'type',item_type,'name',candidate_name,'count',row_count,'ids',ids) FROM (SELECT location_id,item_type,TRIM(name) AS candidate_name,COUNT(*) AS row_count,JSON_ARRAYAGG(id) AS ids FROM attraction GROUP BY location_id,item_type,TRIM(name) HAVING COUNT(*)>1) candidates ORDER BY row_count DESC

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('type',item_type,'name',candidate_name,'count',row_count,'locations',location_count,'ids',ids) FROM (SELECT item_type,TRIM(name) AS candidate_name,COUNT(*) AS row_count,COUNT(DISTINCT location_id) AS location_count,JSON_ARRAYAGG(id) AS ids FROM attraction GROUP BY item_type,TRIM(name) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT location_id)>1) candidates ORDER BY row_count DESC

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('type',item_type,'count',COUNT(*),'missing_description',SUM(NULLIF(TRIM(description),'') IS NULL),'missing_address',SUM(NULLIF(TRIM(address),'') IS NULL),'missing_coordinates',SUM(lat IS NULL OR lng IS NULL),'invalid_coordinates',SUM(CASE WHEN lat < -90 OR lat > 90 OR lng < -180 OR lng > 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),'zero_price_range',SUM(price_min=0 AND price_max=0),'inverted_price_range',SUM(price_min>price_max),'active',SUM(is_active=1)) FROM attraction GROUP BY item_type ORDER BY item_type
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('count',COUNT(*)) FROM hotel h LEFT JOIN location l ON l.id=h.location_id WHERE l.id IS NULL
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('count',COUNT(*)) FROM hotel_image c LEFT JOIN hotel p ON p.id=c.hotel_id WHERE p.id IS NULL
